newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: THOMSON UPGRADES VILNIAUS, HERMIS RATINGS.
newsitem.headline: THOMSON UPGRADES VILNIAUS, HERMIS RATINGS.

text.p: Rating agency Thomson Bankwatch on Wednesday said it has raised its senior debt rating for Vilniaus and Hermis Banks to BB from BB-.
The agency said that Vilniaus continued to be market leader while Hermis maintained an overall satisfactory financial condition.

"Vilniaus Bankas financial results for 1996 showed stable favourable ratios. Bankas Hermis continues to maintain an overall satisfactory financial condition and its financial results for 1996 reflected improving trends and strong ratios," Thomson said in a statement.
"These upgrades denote our belief that both banks will continue to develop and remain the major commercial banks in the market," the agency added.
